get.description:
List Change Events for a specified Project.
See [Filtering on List Actions](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/filtering-on-list-actions) for information on using the filtering capabilities provided by this endpoint.

parameters.name: filters[change_event_status_id][]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Change Event Status ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[change_order_change_reason_id][]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Change Reason ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[change_type_id][]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified Change Type ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[created_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) created within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[include_deleted]
parameters.description: Use 'only' for only deleted resources. Use 'with' for deleted and undeleted resources.

parameters.name: filters[origin_type][]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified origin type(s). Valid values are `Observations::Item`, `Rfi::Header`, `Meeting`, `SiteInstruction`, `CommunicationThread`, and `GenericToolItem`.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description:
Return item(s) last updated within the specified ISO 8601 datetime range.
Formats:
`YYYY-MM-DD`...`YYYY-MM-DD` - Date
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ` - DateTime with UTC Offset
`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00`...`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+XX:00` - Datetime with Custom Offset

parameters.name: include_rfqs
parameters.description: Determines whether to include RFQs in the response. If it's true, or left off, RFQs will be shown in the response. If it is false, RFQs will not be shown.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

id.description: Unique identifier of the Change Event. Use as the {id} path parameter for GET/PATCH /rest/v1.0/change_events/{id}.

number.description: Number with alpha characters stripped out

origin_id.description: Origin ID

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

headers = { 'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN" }

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/change_events?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bchange_event_status_id%5D%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bchange_order_change_reason_id%5D%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bchange_type_id%5D%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bcreated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Binclude_deleted%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Borigin_type%5D%5B%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&include_rfqs=false", headers=headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.summary: Added include_rfqs as an optional parameter
x-changelog.description:
Added a parameter that allows Change Event INDEX response to remove RFQs from the response.

RFQs will be included by default in the Change Events INDEX response. The new parameter takes the following values:

* `true` (the default value if not provided)
* `false`

To exclude RFQs from each Change Event, add `?include_rfqs=false` to the query string.

x-changelog.summary: Add timestamps to Change Events responses

Updated the response in the Change Event endpoints to include full number including revision for the linked rfi:
  - rfi.full_number_with_revision: returns the rfi number including the prefix and revision

x-changelog.summary: Add created_at and updated_at to Change Event Line Items response
x-changelog.description:
Updated the response in the Change Event Line Items endpoints to include created_at and updated_at:
  - created_at: returns the created_at timestamp of the Change Event Line Item
  - updated_at: returns the updated_at timestamp of the Change Event Line Item

x-changelog.summary: Add filter support for Data Extracts
x-changelog.description: Adds filtering support for Change Events used by Data Extracts. New filter parameters added to the index and ecrion endpoints: change_event_status_id, change_type_id, change_order_change_reason_id, and origin_type. A new filter_options endpoint returns available filter values for populating filter dropdowns.

post.description:
Create Change Event.
`change_event_status_id` must identify a Change Event status that exists for the company. Unknown status IDs return 400.
Note: A budget line item will automatically be created for Non-budgeted line items for all new projects and for projects enabled with Non-Budgeted line item beta functionality

title.description: Human-readable title summarizing the Change Event.

number.description: User-defined identifier for the Change Event (may include alphanumeric characters). If omitted on create, one is auto-assigned.

change_event_status_id.description: ID of a Change Event status that exists for the company. Unknown IDs return 400.

change_order_change_reason_id.description: ID of the Change Order Change Reason to associate with this Change Event.

event_scope.description: Scope classification of the Change Event.

event_type.description: Type classification of the Change Event.

origin_data.description: Free-form metadata about the corresponding record in an external (ERP) system.

origin_id.description: External record identifier in the originating source system.

rfi_id.description: ID of the RFI this Change Event originates from, if any.

id.description: ID of an existing Change Event Line Item to update. Omit to create a new Line Item.

budget_code.description: the Budget Code associated to the Change Event Line Item

description.description: Description of the Change Event Line Item.
description.example: Add caulk to bathtub base

enum: Any value present in the Company list of Units of Measure

estimated_cost_calculation_strategy.description: Estimated Cost Calculation Strategy. Controls whether estimated_cost_amount is calculated from the quantity and unit_cost attributes or set manually to a provided value.

change_event_origin_id.description:
ID of the record to associate as the Change Event origin.
Provide alongside `change_event_origin_type`. Send both values as `null` to remove an existing origin.

change_event_origin_type.description: Change Event origin type. Supported values: `GenericToolItem`, `CommunicationThread`, `Meeting`, `Observations::Item`, `Rfi::Header`, `SiteInstruction`.

origin_global_id.description: Global ID of the record to associate as the Change Event origin. Provide instead of `change_event_origin_id` and `change_event_origin_type`.

attachments.description:
Change Event Attachments.
To upload attachments you must upload the entire payload as `multipart/form-data` content-type and
specify each parameter as form-data together with `attachments[]` as files.

x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":345756,\"change_event\":{\"title\":\"Toilet replacement\",\"number\":\"A14\",\"status\":\"open\",\"change_event_status_id\":345998,\"change_order_change_reason_id\":3452,\"event_scope\":\"in_scope\",\"event_type\":\"tbd\",\"origin_data\":\"OD-123654789\",\"origin_id\":\"654987123\",\"rfi_id\":496787,\"change_event_line_items_attributes\":[{\"id\":592648,\"wbs_code_id\":{\"id\":40389},\"description\":\"Add caulk to bathtub base\",\"uom\":\"hours\",\"estimated_cost_amount\":\"17705.0\",\"estimated_cost_quantity\":125.5,\"estimated_cost_unit_cost\":75.5,\"estimated_cost_calculation_strategy\":\"manual\",\"line_item_type_id\":657393,\"cost_code_id\":32940,\"proposed_vendor_id\":58320,\"proposed_contract_id\":234859,\"commitment_contract_line_item_id\":342949}],\"attachments_by_drawing_revision\":[{\"id\":3456}],\"attachments_by_file_version\":[{\"id\":3456}],\"attachments_by_form\":[{\"id\":3456}],\"attachments_by_image\":[{\"id\":3456}],\"attachments_by_uuid\":[{\"upload_uuid\":\"01FG753MPADZBDWA63MH20XQVQ\"}]},\"change_event_origin_id\":5944991,\"change_event_origin_type\":\"GenericToolItem\",\"origin_global_id\":\"gid://procore/GenericToolItem/5944991\",\"attachments\":[\"string\"]}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/change_events/%7Bid%7D?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
